SELECT ec.exception_case_id AS exceptionCaseId, ec.exception_type AS exceptionType, ec.severity, ic.contract_no AS contractNo, ec.title, ec.status, au.login_id AS assignedTo, ec.created_at AS createdAt, ec.source_entity_type AS sourceEntityType, ec.source_entity_id AS sourceEntityId, ec.cap_check_id AS capCheckId FROM fgc.exception_case ec LEFT JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = ec.contract_id LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user au ON au.user_id = ec.assigned_to
ORDER BY CASE ec.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, ec.created_at DESC, ec.exception_case_id DESC

SELECT ec.exception_case_id AS exceptionCaseId, ec.exception_key AS exceptionKey, ec.exception_type AS exceptionType, ec.reason_code AS reasonCode, ec.severity, ec.status, ec.title, ec.description, ec.contract_id AS contractId, ic.contract_no AS contractNo, ag.agent_name AS agentName, ec.assigned_to AS assignedTo, assignee.login_id AS assigneeLoginId, ec.source_entity_type AS sourceEntityType, ec.source_entity_id AS sourceEntityId, ec.cap_check_id AS capCheckId, reconciliation.result_type AS reconciliationResultType, ec.validation_month AS validationMonth, ec.first_detected_run_id AS firstDetectedRunId, ec.last_detected_run_id AS lastDetectedRunId, ec.first_detected_at AS firstDetectedAt, ec.last_detected_at AS lastDetectedAt, ec.detection_count AS detectionCount, ec.created_at AS createdAt FROM fgc.exception_case ec LEFT JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = ec.contract_id LEFT JOIN fgc.agent ag ON ag.agent_id = ec.agent_id LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user assignee ON assignee.user_id = ec.assigned_to LEFT JOIN fgc.reconciliation_result reconciliation ON ec.source_entity_type = 'RECONCILIATION_RESULT' AND ec.source_entity_id = CAST(reconciliation.reconciliation_result_id AS varchar) WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY CASE ec.severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, ec.created_at DESC, ec.exception_case_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.exception_case ec LEFT JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = ec.contract_id WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT exception_type AS exceptionType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fgc.exception_case WHERE status IN ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW') GROUP BY exception_type ORDER BY exception_type
SELECT DISTINCT reason_code FROM fgc.exception_case WHERE reason_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY reason_code
SELECT DISTINCT ec.assigned_to AS userId, au.login_id AS loginId FROM fgc.exception_case ec JOIN fgc.app_user au ON au.user_id = ec.assigned_to ORDER BY au.login_id
SELECT DISTINCT validation_month FROM fgc.exception_case WHERE validation_month IS NOT NULL ORDER BY validation_month DESC
